format.time_domain: monotonic_ns; int64; one clock_id per event stream

transcript_event.value: object with token intervals and text hash

invariants: Events are keyed by (producer_id, tap_id, epoch, event_id); no process-global latest-event register.
An event is admitted only when source_end > source_start >= 0 and its config_digest is a 64-hex SHA-256 string.
An event with epoch below the stream epoch, or from the same epoch before stream_start, is stale and is rejected.
Validity is explicit: unknown means retained but not usable; invalid means rejected; only known events enter scoring.
available_ns is required for known events and must be monotonic in the declared clock domain; signal timestamps are not availability evidence.
Analysis is read-only on PCM: publishing an event cannot mutate the attached audio tuple.
Placement is by exact source interval, never rounded to a hop; cross-hop events contribute exact per-frame overlap counts.
Accuracy runs require hypothesis decisions to cover the scored union exactly: no gaps, overlaps or samples outside scored regions.
Unknown regions outside scored_regions are excluded from denominators and reported as unknown_samples.
A zero denominator produces value null with no_scored_speech or no_scored_nonspeech, never zero.
public_v0_abi: unchanged; this is a proposed versioned interface and model-free fixture only
